inmetr provides verified INMET automatic weather station data for lazy R
queries and nearby-station lookup.

Install from GitHub:

``` r

remotes::install_github("viniciusoike/inmetr")
```

Find a station near São Paulo and collect its daily observations for
2024:

``` r

library(inmetr)

stations <- inmet_nearest(3550308, n = 1)
daily <- read_inmet("daily", years = 2024)
city_daily <- daily |>
  dplyr::filter(.data$code_station %in% stations$code_station) |>
  dplyr::collect()
```

The data release is downloaded on first use into the user cache.
Downloaded files are checked against their SHA-256 hashes. Later reads
check file size; use
[`inmet_cache_clear()`](https://viniciusoike.github.io/inmetr/reference/inmet_cache_clear.md)
to recover from suspected cache corruption.

Daily rows carry `n_hours` for overall coverage. The staged schema 3
release adds a `n_hours_*` column for each aggregate; these columns
become available by default after publication and the package
data-version update. The current default release uses schema 2.

# Package index

## Read data

- [`read_inmet()`](https://viniciusoike.github.io/inmetr/reference/read_inmet.md)
  : Read INMET observations lazily
- [`inmet_stations()`](https://viniciusoike.github.io/inmetr/reference/inmet_stations.md)
  : Read INMET station metadata
- [`inmet_nearest()`](https://viniciusoike.github.io/inmetr/reference/inmet_nearest.md)
  : Find stations nearest a municipality seat

## Cache

- [`inmet_cache_dir()`](https://viniciusoike.github.io/inmetr/reference/inmet_cache_dir.md)
  : Locate the inmetr cache
- [`inmet_cache_clear()`](https://viniciusoike.github.io/inmetr/reference/inmet_cache_clear.md)
  : Clear the inmetr data cache
